title: OSAC Infrastructure Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for OSAC shared infrastructure (Phase 2)

hookResources.description: Resource requests and limits applied to every cliImage hook Job. These hooks invoke `oc`, whose peak memory scales with the cluster's CRD count because of API discovery caching, so the limit is shared rather than set per hook. Raise the memory limit on clusters with unusually large CRD counts.

cpu.description: CPU limit as a Kubernetes quantity, for example 200m or 1

memory.description: Memory limit as a Kubernetes quantity, for example 1Gi or 512Mi

cpu.description: CPU request as a Kubernetes quantity, for example 50m

memory.description: Memory request as a Kubernetes quantity, for example 128Mi

enabled.description: Create and run the Assisted Image Service

bundledPostgres.description: Bundled PostgreSQL for dev/CI and testing only; not intended for production.

topolvm.description: Optional TopoLVM CSI driver for local development clusters.

netbox.description: NetBox deployment for the bmaas_netbox E2E test flavor (dev/CI only; not for production).

enabled.description: Deploy NetBox via the netbox-community subchart.

apiTokenSecret.description: Name of the Secret written into osacNamespace by the post-install seed Job (default: netbox-api-token). Contains the API token for the bare-metal-fulfillment-operator.

bundledVault.description: Bundled OpenBao (Vault-compatible) secret store for testing and CI. Not intended for production.

enabled.description: Deploy a bundled OpenBao instance. Disabled by default — enable in a profile infra.yaml and set keycloakIssuerUrl.

image.description: OpenBao container image (must be 2.5+ for namespace support)

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext for the OpenBao deployment. Defaults to {runAsNonRoot: true} with seccompProfile RuntimeDefault — no hardcoded UID, so OpenShift's restricted-v2 SCC can allocate from the namespace UID range. Any non-nil value here FULLY REPLACES the template default — partial overrides must include every key you want rendered.

keycloakIssuerUrl.description: Keycloak OIDC issuer URL for JWT auth bootstrap. Required when bundledVault is enabled. On OpenShift this must be the external route URL (not the internal service URL) to avoid issuer mismatch.

keycloakAudience.description: Expected aud claim in JWT tokens

vaultNamespace.description: OpenBao/Vault logical namespace (not Kubernetes namespace). The init script creates this as a child namespace inside the OpenBao server and configures JWT auth and policies within it.
